articles.title: Asian Games gold medallist Lovlina gets rousing welcome on return to Assam

articles.title: Khalid Jamil takes responsibility for India's 1-6 defeat against Uruguay
articles.summary: India head coach Khalid Jamil took full responsibility for a heavy 1-6 defeat against Uruguay on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa scored an equaliser in the 22nd minute, but Uruguay secured a comprehensive victory. Jamil refused to blame weather interruptions, accepting full responsibility for mistakes made during the match.
articles.title_hi: खालिद जमील ने उरुग्वे के खिलाफ भारत की 1-6 से हार की जिम्मेदारी ली

articles.title: 'I'll be there': US Olympic Star Backs India's 2036 Bid
articles.summary: US Olympic sprinter Kenny Bednarek supports India's bid to host the 2036 Olympic Games. The twenty-seven-year-old silver medalist cited India's vibrant culture, diverse languages, and his personal connection as key reasons. India is currently one of seven countries competing to host these Olympic Games.
